dataRights.lead: Export the data of your ANTSIA account, shared by all its networks, request its erasure and review the moderation decisions that concern you. These remain available if your membership is suspended.
dataRights.unavailable: These actions are not available here yet.

export.title: Export my data
export.lead: The JSON file gathers what your ANTSIA account holds about you across all its networks: profile, memberships, consents, posts, sent messages… It contains only your own data, never anyone else's. It is assembled in this browser, then saved to your device.

erasure.title: Account erasure
erasure.lead: Erasure covers your whole ANTSIA account and all its networks, DIASPORALE included.
erasure.loadError: The status of your erasure request could not be read.
erasure.scope: The request covers your whole ANTSIA account, across all its networks, not just DIASPORALE.
erasure.grace: Nothing is erased right away: erasure will start in {{days}} days, on {{date}}. Until then, you can cancel your request from this page.
erasure.final: When the time comes, all your sessions will be closed; erasure can no longer be cancelled and nothing can be restored.
erasure.leaveInstead: To only leave DIASPORALE and keep your account, choose “Leave DIASPORALE” instead.
erasure.exportFirst: To keep a copy of your data, download it before confirming.
erasure.requested: Request recorded: erasure will start on {{date}}.
erasure.pending: Erasure requested on {{requested}}. It will start on {{due}}.
erasure.daysLeft_one: You have {{count}} day left to cancel.
erasure.daysLeft_other: You have {{count}} days left to cancel.
erasure.cancelled: Request cancelled: your account is kept.
erasure.processing: Your account is being erased. This can no longer be cancelled; your sessions will be closed.

decisions.title: Moderation decisions
decisions.lead: Decisions taken on your content or your account, across all the networks of your ANTSIA account, their reasons and your appeals. People who reported are never named.
decisions.appealReason: Why are you appealing this decision?
decisions.appealReasonHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. Your reason will be read by the team reviewing the appeal.
decisions.appealSent: Appeal sent: its answer will appear here.
decisions.appealExists: An appeal is already recorded for this decision.

appealLevel.platform: Appeal to the ANTSIA platform team

appealHint.network: Your appeal will be reviewed by the network administration, by someone other than the person who decided.
appealHint.platform: Your appeal will be reviewed by the ANTSIA platform team, by someone other than the person who decided.

errors.erasure_not_cancellable: The cancellation period has passed: erasure can no longer be cancelled.
errors.export_unavailable: Export is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.export_expired: This export is no longer available: request a new one.
errors.export_interrupted: Assembling the file was interrupted; no file was saved. Please try again.
errors.export_cancelled: Export stopped: no file was saved.
errors.export_download_failed: This browser could not save the file.
errors.appeal_reason_length: The appeal reason must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.
